confidence.rationale: The restaurant-issued menu, issued allergen PDF, and restaurant-linked Auburn catalog directly confirm material discrepancies. They also expose overstatements and omissions in Terra's reconciliation while preserving narrow explicit positive ingredient evidence.

confirmedFindings: The packet affects all 44 baseline items and reconciles them as 20 exact_match/accurately_unavailable and 24 missing_from_source/accurately_unavailable.
The official menu explicitly includes Feel Crunch, confirming Luna's S1 enumeration omission.

The reviewed current surfaces differ materially from the frozen 44-item baseline, although the 24 unobserved products can only be described as absent from those reviewed surfaces—not absent restaurant-wide.

The issued allergen PDF is a structured allergen and potential-cross-contaminant matrix, but its catalog does not match the current menu surfaces. It cannot support complete current allergen arrays, negatives, or current product-level cross-contact arrays.
The restaurant-wide food-allergy notice supports a broad cross-contact warning, not item-specific may-contain assignments.

The Auburn descriptions support narrow positives for Ddeok-Bokki and Rose Ddeok-Bokki from fish cakes, egg, and sesame; Chicken Fried Rice from egg and sesame; and Shrimp Tempura from its unavoidable shrimp identity.

The official menu supports additional narrow positives that Terra erased: soy for Honey Garlic and Gang-Jeong, sesame for Galbi, and milk for Cheesling. These positives do not establish complete arrays or negatives.
Count drift, scope incompleteness, authority ambiguity, non-exact reconciliation, PDF/image review, validation-warning, and low-confidence gates remain substantively triggered.
rejectedFindings: Terra's claim that the Auburn surface was fully enumerated and that all current products were checked is false: Chicken Mayo Rice Bowl and Half & Half Whole Chicken appear on the reopened catalog but are absent from Terra's current-product groups.

The deterministic currentProductCount of 37 and currentOnlyCount of 17 are not reliable because at least Chicken Mayo Rice Bowl was omitted; Half & Half Whole Chicken was also omitted as a distinct catalog presentation.

The categorical statement that 24 baseline products are currently stale or absent is too broad. The national menu says offerings vary by restaurant, and one Auburn catalog cannot prove restaurant-wide absence.
Terra's grouped egg/fish/sesame result improperly includes Kimchi Fried Rice even though the cited current description does not explicitly name those allergens.

Terra's unavailable/empty allergen treatment for every chicken flavor and side over-corrects the evidence by discarding explicit restaurant-issued positives and the unavoidable Shrimp Tempura identity.
Neither the incomplete current menus nor the mismatched allergen PDF supports negative allergen findings, complete arrays, or current item-level cross-contact conclusions.

additionalEvidence.summary: Confirms Feel Crunch; identifies flavor presentations; states offerings vary by restaurant; explicitly names soy-based sauces, cheese, and sesame garnish; and provides only a restaurant-wide allergy warning.
Confirms a six-page allergen/potential-cross-contaminant matrix whose product catalog includes numerous items not observed on the reviewed current surfaces.
Confirms the Auburn catalog, explicit egg/fish/sesame descriptions, Shrimp Tempura, and Terra's omissions of Chicken Mayo Rice Bowl and Half & Half Whole Chicken.
